annotations.title: Remove products from a Reddit catalog

description: PERMANENTLY remove products (by id) from a Reddit catalog — Reddit: "This action can't be undone". Up to 1,000 ids per call. Call WITHOUT confirm first: nothing is deleted and the answer says how many would go; get the user's yes, then call again with confirm:true. Reddit answers DELETED or NOT_FOUND per id, and that is what is reported. A catalog fed by a REPLACE feed re-imports whatever the file still contains, so remove the product from the file too.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

confirm.description: true only after the user approved the listed impact

productIds.description: product ids (your SKUs) to remove, up to 1,000 per call
